# DELETE /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{index}/merge

Cancel a scheduled auto-merge for a pull request

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-231`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| index | path | int64 | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — Not the scheduler and no merge permission
- **404** — PR not found or no auto-merge scheduled
- **423** — Repository is archived
